purpose: Teach: 覆い/明かさ/少数/気がつい/人民/調和/振れ/成人

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、症状を覆い隠した患者さん、医療チーム慎重対応しました
lines.en: Ren — we handled that case carefully as a team. The patient's symptoms were obscured.
lines.style: Direct and composed. Speaking from professional experience, not hypothesis. Warm but steady. Slight pause before the explanation, as if choosing the right frame.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病名を明かさないご家族、貴院、配慮されますね、先生
lines.en: The family didn't want the diagnosis shared. Your hospital must have been considerate about that, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, respectful. Ren leans into the question like he's trying to understand the decision-making. Not interrogating — learning. Soft rise on the honorific.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、少数の症例を医療チーム研究しております
lines.en: Yes. We study a limited number of cases as a team to understand them better.
lines.style: Patient and clear. She's not oversimplifying — she's being precise. Slight weight on 'study,' like this is ongoing work that matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医師が気がついた異変、貴院、即対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So when the doctors noticed something was off, your hospital responded right away.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking aloud. Ren isn't asking for confirmation — he's noticing the pattern. Quiet respect underneath. Slight trailing tone, like he's still piecing it together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療は人民の暮らしを支える、貴院も同じ志ですね、先生
lines.en: Healthcare supports people's lives. Your hospital has that same commitment, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: This comes from something genuine in Ren. Not flattery — conviction. He's speaking slowly, like the idea matters to him. Steady eye-contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心と体の調和を医療チーム重視します
lines.en: Yes. We prioritize the balance between mind and body in everything we do as a team.
lines.style: Warm but not effusive. She's confirming something Ren already understands. Slight softness on 'balance,' like she's had to learn this the hard way.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検査値の振れに貴院、注意されているそうですね、先生
lines.en: I hear your hospital pays close attention to those fluctuations in test results.
lines.style: Ren's curiosity again, but quieter this time. He's noticed something specific and is checking his understanding. Respectful distance. Tone like he's asking about something that takes real skill.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、成人病の予防を医療チーム強化中です
lines.en: Yes. We're strengthening our prevention work for adult-onset diseases across the team.
lines.style: Steady and clear, with a note of quiet determination. She's not defending — she's affirming direction. Close and confidential, like she's sharing something important with someone she trusts.
